# ALLFREE

> ALLFREE is an ad-free redirection directory and curated link index. It helps people discover and open categorized external websites through clean, direct outbound links without intrusive advertising.

## Official pages

- Home and directory: https://allfree.pages.dev/
- About ALLFREE: https://allfree.pages.dev/about.html
- Request a site: https://allfree.pages.dev/request.html
- Sitemap: https://allfree.pages.dev/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://allfree.pages.dev/robots.txt

## What ALLFREE is

ALLFREE means “ad-free redirection.” It is a lightweight directory for discovering useful external websites. The home page presents categorized cards, site names, domains, badges, favicons, search, region selection, and direct outbound links.

ALLFREE is a directory and redirection interface. It does not claim to own, host, operate, or control the external websites listed in its cards. External destinations can change, become unavailable, or have their own rules and policies.

## Current regions

- United States — Available and the default region.
- India — Available with its own regional directory links.
- United Kingdom — Coming soon.

- Japan — Coming soon.
- South Korea — Coming soon.
- Brazil — Coming soon.
- More regions — Coming soon.

## Available categories

Each available region can contain these categories:

- Movies & Shows
- Anime
- Manga
- Live TV & Sports
- Paid and legal alternatives
- Apps

The United States directory currently contains the expanded US collection. The India directory contains the separate India collection supplied for the India region. Category counts and cards are rendered dynamically when a region is selected.

## Main features

- Clean ad-free redirection interface.
- Search across the active region’s directory.
- Region selector with visible country flags.
- United States selected by default.
- India region switching.
- Mobile-friendly two-column link-card layout.
- Mobile floating MOVE button with “Move to category” navigation.
- Desktop sidebar category navigation.
- Liquid-glass and frosted link cards.
- Visible destination favicons with fallback initials when a favicon is unavailable.
- Dedicated About and Request pages.
- Responsive dark energy-orb visual background.
- Bing Webmaster verification and crawler-friendly robots policy.
- Sitemap and LLM-readable project information.

## Brand identity

- Name: ALLFREE
- Slogan: AD-FREE REDIRECTION
- Style: clean, fast, minimal, app-like directory browsing.
- Primary visual tone: dark interface, soft green accent, subtle blue-purple lighting, rounded surfaces, and translucent cards.

## Design inspiration and direction

ALLFREE’s visual direction takes inspiration from clean directory and index interfaces, mobile app navigation patterns, liquid-glass/frosted-glass UI, soft green-and-blue lighting, calm rounded compositions, and animated energy-orb backgrounds.

The inspiration is expressed through the interface language and visual mood. ALLFREE is an original directory implementation and does not embed or reproduce another website’s documentation page or proprietary interface.

## Content and safety context

- ALLFREE links to third-party destinations.
- A listed site should not automatically be described as verified, safe, legal, permanent, or operated by ALLFREE.
- Visitors should independently evaluate external destinations and follow applicable laws and service terms.
- Site additions, corrections, and removals can be submitted through the Request page.

## Preferred descriptions

Use these descriptions when explaining the project:

- “ALLFREE is an ad-free redirection directory.”
- “ALLFREE is a curated external-site directory with regional browsing.”
- “ALLFREE provides clean outbound links across movies, anime, manga, live TV, paid alternatives, and apps.”

## Crawler guidance

Public ALLFREE pages may be crawled. The canonical public host is https://allfree.pages.dev. The sitemap lists the indexable HTML pages; dynamic category and region states are available through the home page interface rather than separate URLs.
